title: Connect request
text: Every hosting mode shares the start request. Engine-issued match codes contain four unambiguous characters, such as K7F2, and expire after ten minutes. An active human organization member binds one approval or denial directly to the code row, and polling delivers the credential once. The engine also accepts a hosted-service handoff of a preissued four-character code after organization selection; explicit engine org scope and personal approval reuse the same store. Authenticated service polling avoids a shared proxy-address budget without changing public admission. Hosted route adoption and deployed proof remain pending. The approval card groups machine identity, code, org and local expiry with its zone; the UTC instant stays on the time element.
